# `/campaign-filters` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /campaign-filters/v1

`createCampaignFilterV1` — Create campaign filter

Use this API to create a campaign filter based on filter details and criteria.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:manage
- Body (application/json): campaignfilterdetails
- Returns 200: campaignfilterdetails

### GET /campaign-filters/v1

`listCampaignFiltersV1` — List campaign filters

Use this API to list all campaign filters. You can reduce scope with standard V3 query parameters.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:manage
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `start` (query) — default 0 — Start/Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `includeSystemFilters` (query) — default True — If this is true, the API includes system filters in the count and results. Otherwise it excludes them. If no value is provided, the default is true.
- Returns 200: object

### GET /campaign-filters/v1/{id}

`getCampaignFilterByIdV1` — Get campaign filter by id

Retrieves information for an existing campaign filter using the filter's ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the campaign filter to be retrieved.
- Returns 200: campaignfilterdetails

### POST /campaign-filters/v1/{id}

`updateCampaignFilterV1` — Updates a campaign filter

Updates an existing campaign filter using the filter's ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the campaign filter being modified.
- Body (application/json): campaignfilterdetails
- Returns 200: campaignfilterdetails

### POST /campaign-filters/v1/delete

`deleteCampaignFiltersV1` — Deletes campaign filters

Deletes campaign filters whose Ids are specified in the provided list of campaign filter Ids. Authorized callers must be an ORG_ADMIN or a CERT_ADMIN.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:manage
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 204: no body
